rules.name: Pass-the-Hash Detection
rules.description: Detects NTLM pass-the-hash attacks where an adversary uses a password hash instead of plaintext password
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%pass-the-hash%' OR payload ILIKE '%windows%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Pass-the-Ticket (Kerberos)
rules.description: Detects Kerberos ticket reuse across systems indicating pass-the-ticket attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%pass-the-ticket%' OR payload ILIKE '%kerberos%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: RDP Anomalous Connection
rules.description: Detects anomalous RDP connections including unusual source IPs, off-hours access, or lateral movement patterns
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%rdp%' OR payload ILIKE '%remote-desktop%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SSH Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects SSH connections from compromised hosts to internal systems indicating lateral movement
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%ssh%' OR payload ILIKE '%remote-access%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: WMI/PSExec Remote Execution
rules.description: Detects remote execution via WMI, PSExec, or similar tools indicating lateral movement
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%wmi%' OR payload ILIKE '%psexec%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SMB Lateral Movement via Admin Shares
rules.description: Detects lateral movement through SMB admin shares (C$, ADMIN$) for remote execution
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%smb%' OR payload ILIKE '%admin-shares%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: DCOM Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects DCOM-based lateral movement through distributed COM object activation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%dcom%' OR payload ILIKE '%distributed-com%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: WinRM Remote Shell Access
rules.description: Detects Windows Remote Management shell access for lateral movement and remote execution
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%winrm%' OR payload ILIKE '%remote-shell%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Golden Ticket Attack (Kerberos)
rules.description: Detects Kerberos Golden Ticket attacks where forged TGTs grant persistent domain access
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%golden-ticket%' OR payload ILIKE '%kerberos%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Silver Ticket Attack (Kerberos)
rules.description: Detects Kerberos Silver Ticket attacks using forged service tickets for targeted service access
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%silver-ticket%' OR payload ILIKE '%kerberos%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES
